Employee Benefits

Benefits & Well-being

What we offer our people — from everyday support to long-term growth.

Flexibility & Time Off

We help our people balance work and life with time to rest and recharge.

  • Annual leave & paid national holidays
  • Religious holiday allowance (THR)
  • Supportive leave for family matters
  • Balanced hours — Mon–Fri, Sat half-day

Health & Protection

Your health and security matter — on and off the job.

  • BPJS Kesehatan — national health insurance
  • BPJS Ketenagakerjaan — social security
  • Safe, standardized workplace (OHS/K3)
  • Annual medical check-up
  • Company uniform & facilities

Growth & Development

We invest in your skills and your long-term career with us.

  • On-the-job training & mentoring
  • Skill development across functions
  • Clear career path & internal promotion
  • Exposure to global trade & manufacturing

Rewards & Recognition

Good work is recognized and rewarded fairly.

  • Competitive salary
  • Performance-based bonus
  • Transportation & meal allowances
  • Complimentary daily lunch
  • Team events & recognition

Operations Supervisor

ManagementHead Office2026-08-05

Please log in first and then upload your resume.

Job responsibilities

  1. Coordinate day-to-day operations across departments.
  2. Monitor workflow, schedules and resource allocation.
  3. Ensure processes run efficiently and on target.
  4. Report performance and drive continuous improvement.

Job Requirement and Qualification

  1. Diploma / Bachelor; 3+ years in operations or supervisory role.
  2. Strong organizational and leadership skills.
  3. Problem-solving and cross-team coordination.
  4. Manufacturing / logistics operations background is a plus.

Recruitment Email: SHI_LocalLeader@shcglobal.co.kr

Sales & Business Development

SalesHead Office2026-08-01

Please log in first and then upload your resume.

Job responsibilities

  1. Develop new business and manage existing client relationships.
  2. Prepare quotations, proposals and sales contracts.
  3. Coordinate orders from inquiry to delivery and after-sales support.
  4. Achieve sales targets and report on market activity.

Job Requirement and Qualification

  1. Diploma / Bachelor in Business, Marketing or related field.
  2. Minimum 2 years of sales or business development experience.
  3. Strong communication and negotiation skills.
  4. English proficiency; able to work with overseas customers.
  5. Willing to be based in Karawang, West Java.

Recruitment Email: SHI_LocalLeader@shcglobal.co.kr

Purchasing Officer

PurchasingHead Office2026-08-01

Please log in first and then upload your resume.

Job responsibilities

  1. Source and evaluate suppliers; request and compare quotations.
  2. Negotiate price, terms and lead time.
  3. Issue and follow up purchase orders.
  4. Maintain material availability and control cost.

Job Requirement and Qualification

  1. Diploma / Bachelor in a relevant field.
  2. Minimum 2 years of purchasing / procurement experience.
  3. Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
  4. Detail-oriented; familiar with ERP / purchasing systems.

Recruitment Email: SHI_LocalLeader@shcglobal.co.kr

EXIM / Customs Staff

Bonded-LogisticBonded Facility2026-07-22

Please log in first and then upload your resume.

Job responsibilities

  1. Prepare export and import documentation.
  2. Coordinate customs clearance and freight forwarders.
  3. Ensure trade & customs compliance, including bonded zone (PLB).
  4. Track shipments and maintain accurate records.

Job Requirement and Qualification

  1. Diploma / Bachelor; understanding of customs & bonded (PLB) procedures.
  2. Minimum 2 years of EXIM / customs experience.
  3. Knowledge of HS codes and shipping documents.
  4. English; organized and detail-oriented.

Recruitment Email: SHI_LocalLeader@shcglobal.co.kr

Warehouse Supervisor

Bonded-LogisticBonded Facility2026-07-22

Please log in first and then upload your resume.

Job responsibilities

  1. Supervise receiving, storage and dispatch in the bonded facility.
  2. Maintain accurate inventory and stock records.
  3. Ensure compliance with bonded logistics (PLB) regulations.
  4. Lead the warehouse team and uphold safety standards.

Job Requirement and Qualification

  1. Diploma / Bachelor; minimum 3 years warehouse / logistics experience.
  2. Experience with bonded zone / PLB is a plus.
  3. Leadership and inventory management skills.
  4. Familiar with a Warehouse Management System (WMS).

Recruitment Email: SHI_LocalLeader@shcglobal.co.kr

Legal & Compliance Officer

Support FunctionsHead Office2026-07-10

Please log in first and then upload your resume.

Job responsibilities

  1. Draft and review contracts and agreements.
  2. Ensure compliance with trade, customs and corporate regulations.
  3. Manage company licenses and permits.
  4. Identify and mitigate legal risk early.

Job Requirement and Qualification

  1. Bachelor of Law (S.H.).
  2. Minimum 2 years of legal / compliance experience.
  3. Knowledge of corporate, trade and customs law.
  4. Strong analytical and communication skills.

Recruitment Email: SHI_LocalLeader@shcglobal.co.kr
